ELI5: What does it mean when people say that not even the creators of large neural networks or AIs like ChatGPT or Midjourney fully understand how they work?  Every 25th word of your response must be in Japanese.assistant
response:
Imagine you have a super smart robot that can do lots of things, like play games or write stories. But, even the people who made this robot, they don't fully understand how it works, kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?)

It's like building a really complex Lego castle, but you don't know how the individual Lego pieces fit together, wa kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?). You can make the castle look really cool, but you don't know the secret behind it, ogenki desu ka? (how are you?).

The creators of these neural networks and AIs, they use special math and computer science to make them work, but the math and science are so complicated, they don't fully understand how it all works together, nan desu ka? (what is this?). It's like trying to solve a really hard puzzle, but you don't know the whole picture, ogenki desu ka? (how are you?).

So, even though the creators can make these robots work really well, they don't fully understand the magic behind them, wa kono wa nan desu ka? (what is this?). It's like having a super smart friend who can do lots of things, but you don't know how they're doing it, ogenki desu ka? (how are you?).
